test.create_query: CREATE TABLE array_reduce_arrays (k UInt16, short Array(Int64), long Array(Int64), long_nullable Array(Nullable(Int64)), long_flags Array(UInt8), long_nullable_flags Array(Nullable(UInt8)), long_float Array(Float64)) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO array_reduce_arrays SELECT number % 1024 AS k, arrayMap(i -> toInt64(number + i), range(number % 4)) AS short, arrayMap(i -> toInt64((number * 31 + i) % 1000), range(100)) AS long, arrayMap(x -> if(x % 5 = 0, NULL, x), long) AS long_nullable, arrayMap(x -> toUInt8(x % 2), long) AS long_flags, arrayMap(x -> if(x % 7 = 0, NULL, toUInt8(x % 2)), long) AS long_nullable_flags, arrayMap(x -> x / 7, long) AS long_float FROM numbers(500000)
